name: agent-skills
description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
one_liner: A packaged set of slash commands (spec, plan, build, test, review, ship) that walk an AI coding assistant through a professional software development process instead of just writing code on a whim.
buyer: An engineering lead at a small startup who wants their team's AI-assisted development to follow a consistent, auditable process without writing their own playbook from scratch.
business_use_cases: An engineering manager rolls it out across the team to standardize how everyone uses AI coding tools, reducing wildly inconsistent AI-generated code quality.
A fractional CTO installs it at each client startup as part of a standard 'AI-assisted engineering setup' onboarding package.
A dev-tools vendor studies its command structure as a reference for building a commercial, supported version of the same workflow.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'AI engineering process setup' consulting package for startups, built around installing and customizing this skill set.
Run a subscription workshop/community teaching teams how to use spec-driven AI development with these skills.

steal_this: Package a one-day 'install and tune these skills for your repo' engagement and sell it to three startups you know are already fighting with messy AI-generated code.
